Garage description
Fashioned after the Greek god known for his love of thunderbolts, this paint will signal to your enemies that you're a force not to be taken lightly.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint first appeared on May 28, 2011.
Before the Paint Separation Update, Zeus was worth 250,000 crystals and could be bought from the rank of Generalissimo.
Legacy paint description:
The paint that offers the best protection against Firebird, while also decreasing damage inflicted by Smoky and Freeze. Good for short to mid-range battles. Covers your tank in a pattern of lightning bolts.
